about: Configurations the eval runner compares (node tools/evals.mjs --configs a,b). model forces a Claude Code model for every task and effort its reasoning effort (low, medium, high, xhigh, max); rank forces a rank (and so its turns, note and effort); router lets the Archmage decide; noNote drops the ranks' system notes.

haiku.about: Every task with Haiku 5.5, low effort

sonnet.about: Every task with Sonnet 5.5, medium effort (the baseline)

opus.about: Every task with Opus 5.5, high effort (may not be in a Pro plan)

sonnet-low.about: Sonnet 5.5 with low effort: does effort matter on small tasks?

archimago.about: The Archmage's rules pick rank, model and effort (ranks.json)

sonnet-sin-nota.about: Sonnet 5.5 without the ranks' system notes: do the notes help?
